title: Ngā Āhuatanga Pūhara
requiredTextNote: He herenga ētahi tūtohu kuputuhi, ā, kua whakahohea i ngā wā katoa (e whakaatuhia ana kua monokia).
generating: E waihanga ana i te anga…
featuresWarning: Mā te whakaweto i ēnei kōwhiringa ka ngaro pea ētahi āheinga matua mō te tuhi me te whakahaere.
largeSiteWarning: He maha ngā whārangi o tēnei pae. Tērā pea ka roa te waihanga anga.
skeletonLargeSiteConfirm: E {count} ngā whārangi o tēnei pae. Ka roa pea te hanga anga, ā, ka waihanga he kōnae nui. Haere tonu?
savingPlatformSettingsFailed: I rahua te tiaki i ngā tautuhinga pūhara: {error}
addPageFeatureDescription: Ka taea te waihanga whārangi hou mai i te pae runga, ngā mahi mahere, me ngā mahi rapu tono.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Ka taea te muku whārangi mai i ngā mahi whārangi, ngā mahi mahere, me ngā rerenga kaiwhakahaere e hāngai ana.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i ngā utauta hanganga pae, tae atu ki ngā mahi mahere me ngā mahi kaiwhakahaere Hanganga.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Ka whakaatu i te urunga Aratohu Kāhua i ngā utauta kaiwhakahaere me ngā pokatata rapu tono.
insightsFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i ngā Pūrongo i te kaiwhakahaere me te rapu tono kia wātea ai ngā tirohanga tātaritanga me ngā mōhiotanga.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Ka whakahaere i ngā wāhanga Tautuhinga Pae mō ngā Taipitopito, ngā Poraka, me te whirihoranga Ētita.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i te wāhanga tautuhinga Āhua/Kaupapa Āhua i te whakahaere pae.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i ngā tautuhinga kōtaha kaituhi me ngā raraunga-taapiri kaituhi i te whakahaere pae.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i ngā tautuhinga arotau pūkaha rapu me ngā raraunga-taapiri i te whakahaere pae.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Ka whakaatu i ngā mana whakatika raraunga-taapiri taumata-whārangi pērā i te taitara, te ata, te tūnga, ngā tūtohu, me te raka.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Ka whakaatu i te pūtirotiro poraka, ā, ka taea te tāpiri poraka ihirangi hou i te wā whakatika.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Ka whakaatu i te wāhanga poraka Rongonui i roto i te kaikōwhiri poraka.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Ka whakaatu i te wāhanga poraka Tata Nei i roto i te kaikōwhiri poraka.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Ka whakaatu i te paewhiri mahere/hanganga ihirangi whārangi i te wā whakatika ihirangi.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i te tirohanga pūtake HTML mō te whakatika hāngai i te tohu whārangi.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i ngā tukanga tukuake kōnae me te urunga whakahaere pāpāho/kōnae e hāngai ana.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i ngā paheko pāpāho ā-ipurangi me ngā pūtake rapu pāpāho mamao.
communityFeatureDescription: Ka whakahohe i te horopaki rapu tono e pā ana ki te hapori me ngā mahi toronga.
